quarterly_data.quarter: SJ Semiconductor results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 results briefing: vice president and board secretary Zhou Yan, asked why chiplet integration growth slowed, said results are shaped by downstream industry conditions, customer and product mix and core-material supply; the company is broadening markets, applications and partners to reduce risk. Chairman and CEO Cui Dong said the Jiangyin multi-layer fine-line system-integration packaging project (phase 1) and the Dongsheng Hexin 3D integrated chip manufacturing project (phase 1), both started in H1 2026, are proceeding to plan, and the company kept adding new customers and products in H1. The company said capacity is built dynamically on customers' forecasts and supply-demand changes.
